news.title: Volvo Cars sinks 28% as it swings to Q3 loss, plans 2,500 job cuts
news.sum: Investing.com -- Volvo Cars (ST:VOLCARb) shares sank more than 28% in early Stockholm trading Friday after the company swung to a third-quarter operating loss of 3.7 billion Swedish crowns and said it would cut about 2,500 jobs, as price wars in China and U.S. tariffs hit sales at the Geely-owned carmaker.
